info.title: tenet - an independent type checker for Lean 4 exports, on .NET

commands.name: audit
commands.description: which of a project's declarations are complete and which rest on sorry

commands.name: axioms
commands.description: print the axioms a declaration depends on, transitively

commands.name: check
commands.description: check every module of a built Lake project (.lake/build/lib/lean)

options.name: --all
options.description: also check every imported module, not just the targets

options.name: --only
options.description: check only these declarations; the rest are added unchecked

options.name: --jobs
options.description: worker threads (default: every core; 1 for sequential)

options.name: --fail-on-axiom
options.description: exit non-zero if anything checked rests on that axiom

options.name: --report
options.description: write a JSON report, including a hash of every artifact

options.name: --stats
options.description: print kernel work counters and the most unfolded definitions

options.name: --rules
options.description: which kernel rules the run reached; anything at zero is untested by it

options.name: --slow
options.description: list declarations slower than this (default 1)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: name each declaration before checking it (.olean only)

options.name: --low-memory
options.description: workstation collector: about a third the memory, slower

options.name: --fail-fast
options.description: stop at the first failure

options.name: --quiet
options.description: only the final line

commands.name: compare
commands.description: are two projects stating the same theorem?

commands.name: crosscheck
commands.description: what the .olean reader decodes, against Lean's own exporter

commands.name: info
commands.description: <file.ndjson>               print the export's metadata and counts

commands.name: names
commands.description: list the declarations a target defines (--all includes imports)

commands.name: show
commands.description: <target> <name>...          print declarations in full (type, value, metadata)

commands.name: statement
commands.description: which constants a theorem's statement is built from, and who defines them

commands.name: why
commands.description: the chain from a declaration to each assumption it rests on

options.name: --only
options.description: check only these declarations; everything else is added unchecked

options.name: --fail-fast
options.description: stop at the first failure

options.name: --no-compare
options.description: do not compare derived constructors/recursors with the exporter's

options.name: --quiet
options.description: no progress output

options.name: --stats
options.description: print kernel work counters at the end

options.name: --rules
options.description: which kernel rules the run exercised, and which it never reached

options.name: --verbose
options.description: name each declaration before checking it (.olean files)

options.name: --report
options.description: also write the outcome (counts, failures, slow declarations) as JSON

options.name: --jobs
options.description: check n declarations concurrently (default: number of cores; 1 = sequential)

options.name: --slow
options.description: report declarations slower than this (default 1)

options.name: --stack-mb
options.description: stack size for each checking thread, in MB (default 512)

options.name: --low-memory
options.description: use the workstation garbage collector (about a third of the memory, slower)

options.name: --lib
options.description: add a library root (Root/A/B.olean for module A.B); repeatable. Lake build trees

options.name: --all
options.description: check every module in the import closure, not just the targets
